title: What if the United States took over the world?

lines.text: What if the United States took over the world?
It starts with a vote. Every country says yes to the same offer. A flag goes up over your square. Fifty stars, then one hundred and ninety-five.
By mid-morning the signs change. Kilometers become miles. Twenty degrees is sixty-eight. And your café charges in dollars, with free refills.
By noon the biggest election in history begins. Eight billion voters, one ballot, one very long line. It goes around the square twice.
By sunset you learn the catch. One country, twenty-four time zones. Football means two different sports. And the whole planet files the same tax form in April.
At night, the parade. Fireworks over a city that was another country yesterday. Everyone sings an anthem they learned that afternoon.
So, the biggest country in history, or the longest line at the DMV? You're still in it. It moved one spot.
